## Declarations and implementations

```plato

// Has a finite area and a finite boundary length: closed 2D regions, and flat
// or curved bounded patches in any embedding. (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Area)
interface IArea
{
    Area(x: Self): Number;
    Perimeter(x: Self): Number;
}

// Has a finite enclosed volume and a finite boundary area: closed 3D solids.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Volume)
interface IVolume
{
    Volume(x: Self): Number;
    SurfaceArea(x: Self): Number;
}

//==
// # Centroids

// Can report its center of mass under uniform density in the plane.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Centroid)
interface ICentroid2D
{
    Centroid(x: Self): Point2D;
}

// Can report its center of mass under uniform density in space.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Centroid)
interface ICentroid3D
{
    Centroid(x: Self): Point3D;
}

// A planar shape stored about a centre it is symmetric in: boxes, circles,
// annuli, regular polygons and stars. The centre IS the centroid for such a
// shape, so Center is the only obligation and Centroid arrives derived.
interface ICentered2D
    inherits ICentroid2D
{
    Center(x: Self): Point2D;
}

// A solid or surface stored about a centre it is symmetric in: boxes,
// spheres, cylinders, disks and their shells. Centroid is likewise derived.
interface ICentered3D
    inherits ICentroid3D
{
    Center(x: Self): Point3D;
}

//==
// # IGeometry point queries
//
// What a geometric entity answers about a GIVEN POINT: point membership, the point
// of itself nearest a query, and — for convex shapes — the support mapping that
// GJK-style collision queries are built on.

// Supports a point-membership test in the plane. For closed shapes the boundary
// counts as inside. (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Point_in_polygon)
interface IContainsPoint2D
{
    Contains(x: Self, point: Point2D): Boolean;
}

// Supports a point-membership test in space. For solids the boundary counts as
// inside.
interface IContainsPoint3D
{
    Contains(x: Self, point: Point3D): Boolean;
}

// Can find the point of itself nearest to a query point in the plane. The result
// lies on the shape; for a region it may be an interior point (the query itself
// when contained).
interface INearestPoint2D
{
    ClosestPoint(x: Self, point: Point2D): Point2D;
}

// Can find the point of itself nearest to a query point in space.
interface INearestPoint3D
{
    ClosestPoint(x: Self, point: Point3D): Point3D;
}

// Supplies the support mapping of a convex 2D shape: the farthest point of the
// shape in a given direction. Ties may resolve to any extreme point. The basis
// of GJK-style collision queries. (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Support_function)
interface ISupport2D
{
    Support(x: Self, direction: Direction2D): Point2D;
}

// Supplies the support mapping of a convex 3D shape: the farthest point of the
// shape in a given direction. (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Support_function)
interface ISupport3D
{
    Support(x: Self, direction: Direction3D): Point3D;
}
```
